great customer service! BEAUTIFUL product! perfect addition for our family Crab-i-tat! One of the pools unfortunately was damaged upon arriving and set up, but when I reached out to seller they were FAST to respond and even faster to send a replacement! Great quality and amazing service!
It’s absolutely beautiful. I can’t wait to use this much like a tower of doom for important dice rolls in my game.
I love this. it us exactly 💯 what I needed. holds 2 balks of yarn, perfect for my projects and lightweight.
Exactly what I needed. Works perfect. Thank you!
These hermit crab pools are perfect because the air holes for the water bubblers are large enough that they don’t get clogged all the time. They are easy to clean as well.

I absolutely love these water pools. I've been working on a bigger crabitat for my crabs and these are going to be their new pools. My only issue is the fresh water one is leaking. I would fill it up and walk back about 30 minutes later and it's around half full, though I'm sure I'll be able to figure out the source of the leak soon and get it patched. Other than that, these are absolutely fantastic pools and I highly recommend.
beautiful!
Beautiful colors, great customer service, bubbler works, happy crabs and mom 😊
took a little longer than expected but the owner was very sweet and kept me updated. I am very pleased with how they came out!

These pools are so nice, I was worried they might not be big enough for my jumbo crab to fully submerge but they’re more than big enough! They fit into my tank so well and add a natural looking water area. Definitely recommend!
Great job really enjoyed and is a huge hit at the car shows!
Purchased from buyer several times, never disappointed.
Perfect size for my crabs and they love to climb in and out of the deep pools! Highly reccomend
